Simplify residue cleanup tasks with this stain remover. The drip-free gel formula of this Goo Gone stain remover is easy to apply to problem areas and lets you quickly clear sticky and greasy stains from equipment and furnishings without causing surface damage.
• Spray gel with a citrus scent clings to stains and sticky messes while protecting the surface below
• Comes in 12 fl. oz. spray bottle
• One spray bottle per pack
• Easily remove gum, crayon, adhesive, adhesive residue, glue, and more
• Safe for use on carpet, finished wood, sealed stone, painted surface, glass, fabric, metal, plastic, ceramic, and porcelain
• Perfect for cleaning glasses, area rugs, walls
• Spray gel is designed specifically to cling to stains and vertical surfaces, making it a versatile adhesive remover
• Drip-free formula allows you to clean the mess without harming the surface below
• Excellent to help you remove gum residue from carpet
• Do not use on silk, leather, suede, rubber, faux stainless steel, drywall, unfinished wood surfaces, unsealed stone
Petroleum Distillates, D-Limonene

First Aid Treatment: If swallowed, call a Poison Control Centre or doctor immediately. Do not induce vomiting. If in eyes or on skin, rinse well with water. If on clothes, remove clothes. If breathed in, move person into fresh air., Danger: Harmful or fatal if swallowed. Read cautions on back panel. Do not use on: Silk, leather, suede, rubber, faux stainless steel, unpainted drywall, unfinished wood surfaces, and unsealed stone. Do not swallow. Do not get in eyes or on skin or clothing. keep out of reach of children and pets.

Directions: Pre-test on an inconspicuous area. Hard Surfaces: 1. Apply Goo Gone to mess. 2. Allow a few minutes for Goo Gone to begin working. 3. Wipe with a clean white cloth. 4. Clean area with soap and water. Carpet: 1. Apply Goo Gone to clean white cloth. 2. Gently blot stain. 3. Clean area with soap and water. Clothing: Do not treat clothing while wearing. 1. Apply Goo Gone to stain. 2. Blot with clean white cloth. 3. Launder separately using extra detergent. Use only per label directions.
